# ISA Archive (Yoonjong Ryu)

> Official engineering portfolio and project archive of ISA (Yoonjong Ryu / 류윤종), a Frontend & Mobile Security Engineer specializing in Component-Driven Development (CDD), scalable UI architecture, Progressive Web Apps (PWA), and zero-knowledge on-device cryptography.

- Website: https://yoonjonglyu.github.io/
- GitHub: https://github.com/yoonjonglyu
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ryuislabs.seedvault
- RyuisLabs: https://ryuislabs.com/

## Core Competencies & Tech Stack
- **Frontend Architecture**: React 19, Next.js 16 (App Router), TypeScript, styled-components, Tailwind CSS 4, Jotai, Storybook 10.
- **Mobile & Hybrid Systems**: Capacitor 8 (Android/iOS), Flutter, Serwist (Service Worker PWA).
- **Security & Cryptography**: On-Device Zero-Knowledge architecture, WebAssembly Argon2id Key Derivation (KDF), AES-256-GCM Authenticated Envelope Encryption, Air-Gapped QR code backup.
- **Methodologies**: Component-Driven Development (CDD), Offline-First UX, Multi-Locale SSG (KO, EN, JA, ZH-TW).

## Featured Works (Career & Production Apps)
- [ABILITY: Gravity & Time](https://yoonjonglyu.github.io/work/ability-gravity): Sci-Fi themed high-immersion timer app built with Flutter, Wakelock, and native alarm integrations.
- [Asharyu Design System](https://yoonjonglyu.github.io/work/asharyu-design): Cross-framework design token system and atomic web component library published on npm (`asharyu-design-token`).
- [SeedVault](https://yoonjonglyu.github.io/work/seedvault): On-device zero-knowledge security vault mobile app built with Argon2id + AES-256-GCM, released on Google Play (`com.ryuislabs.seedvault`).
- [ABILITY: DaoXin](https://yoonjonglyu.github.io/work/daoxin): Eastern cultivation philosophy routine tracker validating atomic state management with React, Jotai, Vanilla CSS, and Capacitor.
- [MemoFlow](https://yoonjonglyu.github.io/work/memo): Component-Driven PWA planner app designed for volatile, offline-first thought organization.
- [ISA Archive](https://yoonjonglyu.github.io/work/isa-archive): Next.js 16 and Contentlayer2 static portfolio platform with 4-locale client-side translation.
- [Custom Swipe](https://yoonjonglyu.github.io/work/custom-swipe): Zero-dependency touch gesture and swipe physics engine for mobile web interfaces.
- [ISA Util](https://yoonjonglyu.github.io/work/isa-util): Collection of performant, production-tested frontend utility functions.

## Projects & Research
- [SeedVault](https://yoonjonglyu.github.io/archive/project/seedvault): Deep dive into the cryptographic envelope architecture and regulatory-to-product pivot from SeedWallet.
- [RyuisLabs Platform](https://yoonjonglyu.github.io/archive/project/ryuislabs): Engineering platform for on-device AI vision and deep-tech indie products (`RYUis : STATUS`).
- [Jeonju Ryu Clan Digital Archive](https://yoonjonglyu.github.io/archive/project/jjryuarchive): Digital historical genealogy archive powered by Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS 4.
- [MemoFlow Project](https://yoonjonglyu.github.io/archive/project/memo): Technical analysis on offline-first state synchrony and PWA service worker caching.

## Open Source Packages
- [asharyu-design-token](https://yoonjonglyu.github.io/archive/package/asharyu-design): Core color, typography, and spacing tokens for engineering UIs.
- [custom-swipe](https://yoonjonglyu.github.io/archive/package/custom-swipe): Lightweight touch swipe gesture detection utility.
- [isa-util](https://yoonjonglyu.github.io/archive/package/isa-util): Comprehensive TypeScript helper library.
- [react-daumpost-hook](https://yoonjonglyu.github.io/archive/package/react-daumpost-hook): Zero-dependency React hook for Korean Daum address postal search integration.
